title: Improvement of Appendix Identification and Appendicitis Diagnosis in us After Administration of Oral Contrast Medium
brief_summary: Rate of appendix localization on ultrasound is not high. We suggest a way to improve it's localization by oral administration of iodinated contrast material.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients in emergency department with right lower quadrant pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients under 18 years old
* pregnant women
